'''Kavakoderakanbnuarria''' was a [[Kriek]] and leader of the [[Kherkhaman]], a tribe that claimed the entire northern continent of [[Dekok]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kriekaal]]. His name meant "bringer of the mountain of the glorious tribe Kherkhaman" and his name was occasionally shortened to "Kavakoder" by his subjects. Kavakoderakanbnuarria was the first leader to meet the [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] team from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Korren Starchaser]].<ref name="Scout" />
